name: stats-section-v6
title: Stats Section v6
description: A support stats section with a bento grid of waffle charts. The left column has the title and description. The right column has one tile per support channel, sized by rank, with its share, wait time, and a small 10 by 10 grid. Each grid lights only that channel's squares, in the same spots they hold in the full 100, so the four grids add up to one chart. The two smallest channels show only the two rows that hold their squares, drawn at full tile width so they read at the same scale as the others. Lit squares fill in on load, then breathe in a slow diagonal shimmer. Static data, no API.
